retainedFailuresAndLimits.name: Initial combined portability suite
retainedFailuresAndLimits.result: 157 tests: 86 passed and 71 failed. This included 62 service expectations/fixtures and 9 route-argument expectations; route expectations were corrected and the focused route suite passed, while the 62 service failures remain unresolved and are not dismissed as regressions or qualified by this checkpoint.

retainedFailuresAndLimits.name: Portability failure audit
retainedFailuresAndLimits.result: Read-only follow-up identified54 failed export fixtures blocked by missing native current actor/company; downstream serializer behavior remains unqualified. Eight failed import cases require explicit cross-company source publication, not merely a fixture actor. Existing deliberate rejection assertions remain authoritative.

rateBudgetChange: All four custom authRateLimits upserts now use an independent random UUID for the row id while preserving the logical key and its ON CONFLICT target. No consumer was found that depends on id equaling key. The pre-fix failure is consistent with a concurrent insert race, but the old diagnostic did not record the exact constraint and the checkpoint does not claim that the primary-key constraint was proven to be the cause.
archivedScratch: Closed support-export-*, support-concurrent-*, and support-rate-race-* artifacts were copied from /workspace/v10-preparation. Active browser work, unrelated files, and tsbuildinfo were excluded.
